daily.summary: Energy operators feature again. Peninsula Energy says a cyber incident breached operating systems at its Wyoming uranium mine and halted trading in its shares, and KEPCO's breach is now under regulator investigation. GreyNoise reports an AI-assisted actor holding access to Check Point management servers at 22 organizations, including energy and government. The UK NCSC says attacks using agentic offensive frameworks have risen markedly since September, exploiting old weaknesses faster.

weekly.summary: AI-assisted intrusion remains the week's main theme. The FBI, the UK NCSC, Google, Unit 42, Amazon and GreyNoise describe agentic attack frameworks in real operations, and Bell Canada and the European Commission say AI-driven attackers breached them. Energy operators feature prominently: Norway reportedly links Equinor and Skagerak Energi incidents to an exploited Azure API Management flaw, KEPCO disclosed a large data breach and a US uranium mine was disrupted. State-linked activity includes a China-nexus vCenter zero-day campaign, Russian espionage against Romanian and US targets, and North Korean financial theft. Government breaches in Austria, West Virginia and at the FBI remain unattributed.
